entities.title: High-score Worker
entities.summary: The Cloudflare Worker: the signed-in game page, the high-score API, the public scores page and the old address's redirect.
entities.purpose: Serves the game behind icelander.net's sign-in, issues each reign's seed, replays submitted reigns headless with the game's own engine, and keeps the table in D1. Its schema is schema.sql; later changes to the live database are in migrations/.
boundaries: Static files are served by Cloudflare's assets, not by this code; only the game's page itself runs through it first.
The engine and the name rules are src/'s, imported, never copied.
The sign-in is vendor/icelander-auth's, with icelander.net's login service behind the ACCOUNTS binding.
